content.thinking: Add a docstring. Watch out for the metadata position: (defn cache-file ^java.io.File ...). In Clojure, docstrings come after the symbol (and metadata like namespaced forms). The syntax: (defn cache-file "doc" ^java.io.File [args] ...) — actually, docstrings must come before any metadata keywords, but ^java.io.File is a tag... can tags be used together with docstrings? In Clojure, a docstring must be the first literal in the form after the name; metadata like ^java.io.File is a tag (metadata map). Order: (defn name "docstring" ^type [params]...) — this works: the docstring becomes the :doc of the metadata map, and ^type also merges in. Yes, in modern Clojure it's allowed: (defn foo "doc" ^int [x] ...).
